senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) gent. n. K’rethi, Cherethi; (collect.) the body-guard of David; (homilet.) the Sanhedrin (or Urim and Tummim).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 3:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. III</cite>, V. <cite ref="K01181"><he>כְּרִיתָה</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>כְּרֵתִיִּים</he>.
Men. 28ᵇ כמין תפוחי הכ׳ ed. (ed. Ven., a. oth., and Ar. הבִּרְתִּיִּים) the shape of the apples of the K’rethiim (Cretans?); ib. 63ᵃ הכ׳ Ms. R. 2 (ed. הברתים), v. בִּירְתִית.
